title: Verified Farkas infeasibility certificates from (tau,kappa)
description: Detect + VERIFY primal/dual infeasibility in ball arithmetic from HSDE (tau->0,kappa>0 etc.); emit verified Farkas certificate, not a float heuristic. TDD on infeasible + unbounded fixtures.
acceptance_criteria: ctest: infeasible/unbounded fixtures yield verified certificates; feasible problems never misclassified; zero leaks.

title: Jansson [lb,ub] + asdp_result + status; bracket property test
description: Jansson lower bound opt>=b^T y + sum_b min(0,lambda_min(Z_b))*xbar_b and the dual-side upper bound -> rigorous [lb,ub]; build asdp_result; status optimal/inconclusive. KEY property test: the bracket CONTAINS the constructed optimum (CLAUDE rule 2; excluding it is P0).
acceptance_criteria: ctest: for >=5 problems with known optima the rigorous bracket contains the optimum; gap reported; zero leaks.

title: Dual residual Z (ball) + a-priori trace-bound API
description: Compute Z_b = C_b - sum_i y_i A_i^b in ball arithmetic from an approximate y; expose per-block a-priori tr X <= xbar API input (CLAUDE invariant 5: no silent boundedness). TDD.
acceptance_criteria: ctest: Z enclosure contains exact residual; missing bound -> reported (lb=-inf), never silent; zero leaks.
notes: DECISIONS (from b03): prec_c=prec+128 initially, escalates independently; dual norm bound ybar is a first-class input symmetric to xbar; DERIVE the KKT-slackness formula for ybar and write it into MATH_SPEC during this bead; no ybar => ub=+inf reported. See MATH_SPEC.md §10.2/§10.3.

title: Verified Cholesky PSD test + lambda_min lower bound (ball)
description: Layer-1 kernels in BALL arithmetic: arb_mat_cho success is a PROOF of PD; lambda_min(A) lower bound via largest s with cho(A - s I) succeeding (binary search), Gershgorin fallback. NOT eig (CLAUDE invariant 2). TDD.
acceptance_criteria: ctest: cho succeeds iff PD on a sweep; lambda_min lower bound brackets true min eigenvalue on known-spectrum fixtures; zero leaks.

title: Adaptive precision controller (escalate/caps/stall)
description: src/precision.c: escalate prec (~ c*(-log2 mu)+margin) on Schur ill-conditioning / gap stall; prec_max + iter_max caps -> best iterate + 'limit' status. TDD on an ill-conditioned moment-matrix case float64 fails.
acceptance_criteria: ctest: ill-conditioned case solved to requested digits with auto escalation; caps yield honest limit status; prec_history recorded.
notes: DECISION (from b03): stall = muNew>0.99*mu (1%), K=stallIterCap=10. See MATH_SPEC.md §10.5.

title: HSDE-NT main loop (fixed prec) matches TS + golden
description: Wire solve.c main loop at FIXED prec. Solve tiny analytic SDPs; cross-check vs scientist-workbench sdp-solve AND a golden analytic optimum (beat-or-bracket per CLAUDE rule 4).
acceptance_criteria: ctest: optimal value matches analytic + TS to working precision on >=3 small SDPs; zero leaks.

title: Mehrotra predictor-corrector direction + PSD step length
description: Affine (sigma=0) + corrector (sigma=(mu_aff/mu)^3 clipped) sharing one factorization; step-to-boundary keeping X,S,tau,kappa in cone (port HsdeStepLength + psdMaxStep) with Mehrotra safeguard. TDD.
acceptance_criteria: ctest: step keeps iterates feasible (PSD, tau,kappa>0); on a tiny SDP one iteration decreases mu; zero leaks.
notes: INFRA NOTE (from b01): factor-once/solve-many = arb_mat_cho + arb_mat_solve_cho_precomp; predictor+corrector share ONE Schur factor. See docs/FLINT_NOTES.md gotcha 3.

title: 3-way Tikhonov regularization (delta_p,delta_d,delta_g)
description: Port Regularization.ts: bump-on-failure 3-way Tikhonov with caps; keep books separate from the ORIGINAL problem (CLAUDE invariant 4). TDD on a near-singular Schur.
acceptance_criteria: ctest: regularized factor succeeds where unregularized fails; deltas escalate within caps; recorded for diagnostics.
notes: DECISIONS (from b03): carry delta across iterations (match TS, no reset-per-iter); maxRefactor=20. See MATH_SPEC.md §10.4/§10.6.

title: Schur assembly + arb Cholesky factor/solve
description: Assemble NT-scaled Schur M_ik=sum_b <A_i^b, W^b A_k^b W^b> (port SchurAssembler); factor + solve via arb_mat_cho/solve. TDD M symmetric PD; solve residual small.
acceptance_criteria: ctest: M symmetric; M x = r solved to prec on PD fixtures; zero leaks.

title: HSDE iterate + 3-row residuals + 6-flag convergence
description: Port HsdeIterate/Residuals/Convergence: HSDE iterate state with (tau,kappa); primal Ax-b*tau, dual A^T y+s-c*tau, gap residuals; 6-flag convergence scaled by ||b||,||c||. Point-mode arb. TDD.
acceptance_criteria: ctest: residuals zero at a constructed feasible point; convergence flags fire on a converged fixture; zero leaks.

title: NT scaling (point mode) + WSW=X identity test
description: Implement ntScaling W=X^{1/2}(X^{1/2} S X^{1/2})^{-1/2} X^{1/2} in point mode (port PsdCone.ts ntScaling). TDD the defining identity W S W = X.
acceptance_criteria: ctest: W S W = X to prec on random PD (X,S); symmetric; zero leaks.

title: linalg arb_mat helpers + approx spectral (point mode)
description: src/linalg.c: symmetrize, frobInner, matmul wrappers over arb_mat; triangular solves; APPROXIMATE eig/sqrt/invsqrt in point mode (port eighJacobi from PsdCone.ts OR wrap arb_mat_approx_eig_qr). These are Layer-0 only; NOT rigorous. TDD against hand-checked small matrices.
acceptance_criteria: ctest: sqrt(A)^2=A and A^{-1/2} A A^{-1/2}=I to prec on PD fixtures; eig matches known spectra; zero leaks.
notes: DECISION (from b01/FLINT_NOTES): arb_mat.h has NO eigendecomposition (real-symmetric eig absent). VERDICT: port the cyclic-Jacobi eig from PsdCone.ts (pure real-arb, point mode) rather than round-trip through acb_mat. acb_mat_eig_* exists only as an optional cross-check oracle. See docs/FLINT_NOTES.md gotcha 1.

title: svec module + roundtrip tests
description: src/svec.c + include: vectorize symmetric block matrices with strict-Mosek sqrt2 off-diagonal scaling so <A,X>=svec(A).svec(X); block bookkeeping; smat<->svec roundtrip. RED-GREEN TDD; ground truth = MATH_SPEC + PsdCone.ts. ASan clean.
acceptance_criteria: ctest: svec/smat roundtrip exact; <A,X> via svec matches dense Frobenius to prec; multi-block layout correct; zero leaks.
notes: DECISION (from b03): svec = upper-triangle column-major, k=j*(j+1)/2+i (0-idx, i<=j), diag unscaled, strict-upper *sqrt(2). Pin in svec.h. See MATH_SPEC.md §10.1.

title: MATH_SPEC.md: ground-truth distillation (HSDE-NT + Jansson)
description: Write docs/MATH_SPEC.md distilling exact formulas to be coded, each cited to source: (a) HSDE-NT Mehrotra iteration from scientist-workbench HsdeNtSdpSolver.ts + PsdCone.ts (residuals, NT scaling W with WSW=X, Schur M_ik=sum_b <A_i^b, W^b A_k^b W^b>, predictor/corrector, step-to-boundary, 6-flag convergence, sign convention min -<C,X>); (b) Layer-1 Jansson-Chaykin-Keil lower AND dual-side upper bound in the strict-Mosek sqrt2 svec convention, with the verified-Cholesky-shift lambda_min routine; (c) the adaptive precision controller. No code, just the contract.
acceptance_criteria: docs/MATH_SPEC.md exists; every formula cites a paper eq or a TS file:line; sqrt2 svec convention stated once; matches PRD section 4.
close_reason: MATH_SPEC.md written (842 lines), all formulas cited to TS file:line or paper; 6 open questions adjudicated in §10.

title: Repo skeleton + CMake build + trivial ctest
description: Create c/ tree (include/arbsdp/api.h, src/, test/) and c/CMakeLists.txt linking flint/mpfr/gmp with flags -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Wshadow -Wstrict-prototypes -O2 -g -std=c11 and a -DENABLE_ASAN option. Implement arbsdp_version() and ONE ctest that asserts it. README stub.
acceptance_criteria: cmake -S c -B c/build && cmake --build c/build && ctest --test-dir c/build green; ASan build links.
close_reason: c/ skeleton + CMake (pkg-config flint 3.0.1, -lmpfr -lgmp, standard warning flags, ENABLE_ASAN option) + arbsdp_version() + test_version ctest. Independently verified: clean build (no warnings), ctest 1/1 green normal + ASan.

title: Install FLINT 3.0.1 + verify Arb symbols
description: BLOCKED on owner sudo: 'sudo apt-get install -y libflint-dev' (FLINT 3.0.1, bundles Arb). Then write docs/FLINT_NOTES.md recording the installed version and the CONFIRMED symbol spellings used by this project (arb_mat_cho / arb_mat_solve / arb_mat_mul / arb_mat_approx_eig_qr / arb_get_str etc.) checked against /usr/include/flint headers. Per CLAUDE.md rule 12, names drift across releases.
acceptance_criteria: flint headers present under /usr/include/flint; a 5-line C program that arb_mat_init/cho/clear compiles with -lflint -lmpfr -lgmp and runs clean under ASan; docs/FLINT_NOTES.md lists confirmed symbols + version.
close_reason: FLINT 3.0.1 confirmed; docs/FLINT_NOTES.md lists verified symbols. arb_mat_cho return=1 is a rigorous PD proof (probe passes under ASan/UBSan, -Werror clean). No eig in arb_mat -> b05 ports Jacobi.

title: arbsdp: arbitrary-precision rigorously-bounded SDP solver (epic)
description: Build libarbsdp (C, FLINT/Arb) + ArbSDP.jl. Solve small SDPs in arb precision, return rigorous ball [lb,ub] + verified status. Architecture: solve-in-points (Layer0 HSDE-NT IPM) / certify-in-balls (Layer1 Jansson). See PRD.md and CLAUDE.md. Children are chained b01..b23.

title: Golden-master regression suite (beat-or-bracket) in CI
description: Wire the golden set into ctest + Pkg.test as regressions: every problem must BEAT (more digits) or BRACKET (interval contains) each stored reference (analytic, wolfram, TS, JuMP solvers, Mosek/COPT). Emit a report; log every silent cap.
acceptance_criteria: regression suite green; report lists per-problem (our [lb,ub], references, digits_agreed, brackets?, prec, iters).

title: Julia full FFI binding + solve() API + marshaling
description: ArbSDP.jl: full ccall surface, solve(problem; prec, trace_bounds) -> Result with BigFloat/Arb [lb,ub], X/y enclosures, status. SERIAL Julia only.
acceptance_criteria: Pkg.test green: solve a golden problem end-to-end via the C lib; result matches the CLI.

title: CLI 'arbsdp solve' + JSON result serializer
description: src/cli.c: 'arbsdp solve problem.dat-s --prec N --trace-bound ...' -> JSON asdp_result (midpoint+radius strings). TDD the serializer.
acceptance_criteria: ctest/CLI: solves a fixture and prints valid JSON with [lb,ub] + status; round-trips through a parser.

title: Julia golden oracles: JuMP solvers + Mosek/COPT + SDPLIB-small
description: Wire reference oracles in ArbSDP.jl/bench: JuMP+Clarabel/Hypatia/SCS to emit float64 references; drivers for the on-disk Mosek (../MOSEK-decomp/mosek) and COPT (../COPT-decomp/copt) binaries; fetch SDPLIB-small subset. Store references + provenance under golden/.
acceptance_criteria: For each golden problem, at least 2 independent reference values stored with provenance; SERIAL execution.

title: wolframscript golden generator + analytic SDP set
description: Use wolframscript (1.13.0, available) to generate analytic SDPs with closed-form optima (and high-precision references) into golden/ with provenance JSON. Curate a small set incl. boundary/rank-deficient optima. Also a few hand-built closed-form cases.
acceptance_criteria: golden/ holds >=5 problems each with .dat-s + provenance + reference optimal value at >=50 digits; a Julia/script check reproduces them.
close_reason: 7 golden SDPs generated via wolframscript with 65-digit closed-form optima (incl. rank-deficient boundary cases sdp_sqrt2/trivial_2x2/max_eig_tridiag, an LP-diagonal block, a mixed-block case, and a mildly ill-conditioned case). verify.wl: 7/7 exact agreement. Schema in golden/README.md.

title: ArbSDP.jl scaffold + ccall version smoke
description: Scaffold ArbSDP.jl (Project.toml, src/ArbSDP.jl) that dlopens libarbsdp and ccalls arbsdp_version(). SERIAL Julia only (no parallel julia processes per owner). deps build via local libarbsdp.
acceptance_criteria: Pkg.test green: ccall arbsdp_version returns the expected string.

title: SDPA .dat-s reader + fixtures
description: src/io.c: parse SDPA sparse .dat-s into the multi-block problem struct (port format/SdpaSparse.ts semantics). Add small golden/ fixtures. RED-GREEN TDD.
acceptance_criteria: ctest: parse fixtures -> expected m, block sizes, C/A entries; roundtrip/echo; malformed input fails loud; zero leaks.
notes: DECISION/GOTCHA (from b09): SDPA .dat-s off-diagonal entry (k,l,v) with k<l means A_kl=A_lk=v, so <A,X> contribution is 2*v*X_kl. The reader must apply the 2v doubling for off-diagonals (matches SdpaSparse.ts). Golden generator already encodes objective off-diagonals as v=1/2 to compensate. See golden/README.md.

title: ArbSDP_jll packaging (BinaryBuilder/Yggdrasil)
description: Package libarbsdp as a JLL so ']add ArbSDP' installs a prebuilt binary.
acceptance_criteria: a clean machine can add ArbSDP and solve without a local C build.

title: MathOptInterface / JuMP backend
description: Implement an MOI backend so ArbSDP plugs into JuMP (and the golden harness gains uniform solver access). SERIAL Julia only.
acceptance_criteria: a JuMP model with PSD constraints solves through ArbSDP and returns the rigorous bracket.

title: Layer 2 refinement (interval-Newton / Krawczyk)
description: When Layer-1 returns inconclusive with a finite but wide gap: precision-bump-resolve, and/or a Krawczyk/interval-Newton contraction on the KKT box that PROVES a solution lies inside, tightening [lb,ub]. TDD.
acceptance_criteria: ctest: inconclusive cases with wide gaps are tightened to optimal; contraction proof recorded.
